preparation.base: Official ExpansionHunter v5.0.0 precompiled binary (GitHub Releases, documented in `docs/02_Installation.md`)
preparation.without_preparation: Automated verification builds from source following `docs/02_Installation.md` (line 19), which lists `zlib1g` instead of `zlib1g-dev` on Ubuntu, causing CMake to stop before compilation. In addition, even with all development headers present, `CMakeLists.txt` (line 44) hardcodes the retired `boostorg.jfrog.io` URL for Boost 1.73.0, which now returns an HTML redirect instead of a tarball.

recommendations: In `docs/02_Installation.md` (line 19), replace `zlib1g` with `zlib1g-dev` so Ubuntu/Debian source builds have the required ZLIB development headers.

In `CMakeLists.txt` (line 44), replace the retired `https://boostorg.jfrog.io/artifactory/main/release/1.73.0/source/boost_1_73_0.tar.bz2` URL with the official Boost archive (`https://archives.boost.io/release/1.73.0/source/boost_1_73_0.tar.bz2`) so clean source builds succeed again.

Add a copyable installation command for the official GitHub Release tarball (or Bioconda `expansionhunter=5.0.0`) directly in `README.md` so automated evaluators can run v5.0.0 without compiling Boost from source.

verdict.title: Runs in manual verification
verdict.reason: Using the official precompiled ExpansionHunter v5.0.0 release binary documented in `docs/02_Installation.md` (lines 3-5) with zero modifications to upstream code, ExpansionHunter ran end-to-end on the GIAB NA12878 autosomal Illumina BAM slice (hg38) and genotyped all 24/24 forensic STR loci in the reference panel with PASS status.

summary.purpose: Independent manual verification of reproducible execution on unmodified upstream source.
summary.result: Using the official precompiled ExpansionHunter v5.0.0 release binary documented in `docs/02_Installation.md` (lines 3-5) with zero modifications to upstream code, ExpansionHunter ran end-to-end on the GIAB NA12878 autosomal Illumina BAM slice (hg38) and genotyped all 24/24 forensic STR loci in the reference panel with PASS status.
summary.why: Automated verification failed to compile from source because the Ubuntu install instructions omit `zlib1g-dev` and `CMakeLists.txt` points to a retired Boost download URL. In manual verification, using the official precompiled v5.0.0 binary documented by the authors (without modifying any code), ExpansionHunter ran end-to-end and called all 24 forensic STR loci (see Section 4 for exact steps).
summary.scope: Reproducible execution only; does not evaluate genotype concordance or forensic casework fitness.

conclusion.title: ExpansionHunter v5.0.0 executes end-to-end
conclusion.body: ExpansionHunter v5.0.0 ran to completion without code modifications in the prepared environment at unmodified upstream commit 9f5db1d.

conclusion.title: Output passes plausibility checks
conclusion.body: The run produced a structurally valid, non-empty VCF output containing 24 distinct recognizable STR loci; structural plausibility checks verify output format and locus presence, not genotype accuracy.

conclusion.title: Verification used STRhub reference data
conclusion.body: Verification used open-access STRhub reference dataset Illumina BAM (hg38), NA12878 (autosomal, female) (illumina-bam-hg38).

conclusion.title: Repeatability of this manual run
conclusion.body: The pinned upstream commit, prepared environment description, exact commands executed, and sanitized terminal output recorded in this report document the procedure for independent reproduction.

limitations: Results apply exclusively to the exact Git commit SHA and manually prepared environment recorded in this report.
Single regional reference slice per input type; low-coverage warnings on sliced BAMs do not imply defects on whole-genome data.
Plausible Output checks verify structural format and recognizable STR loci, not biological genotype truth.
Verification is a point-in-time snapshot; upstream repository changes after this commit are not covered until re-verification.
No truth-set concordance, forensic casework validation, or regulatory compliance assessment was performed.

scope.not: It does not establish genotype accuracy or forensic casework fitness.

es.plain_why: La verificación automática falló al compilar desde fuente porque las instrucciones de Ubuntu omiten `zlib1g-dev` y `CMakeLists.txt` apunta a una URL retirada de Boost. En verificación manual, usando el binario oficial precompilado v5.0.0 documentado por los autores (sin modificar código), ExpansionHunter corrió de principio a fin y genotipó los 24 loci STR forenses (ver Sección 4 para los pasos exactos).
es.without_preparation: La verificación automática compila desde código fuente siguiendo `docs/02_Installation.md` (línea 19), que lista `zlib1g` en lugar de `zlib1g-dev` en Ubuntu, por lo que CMake se detiene antes de compilar. Además, incluso con todas las cabeceras de desarrollo instaladas, `CMakeLists.txt` (línea 44) apunta a la URL retirada `boostorg.jfrog.io` para Boost 1.73.0, que devuelve una redirección HTML en lugar del archivo `.tar.bz2`.
es.reason: Usando el binario oficial precompilado del release ExpansionHunter v5.0.0 documentado en `docs/02_Installation.md` (líneas 3-5) y sin modificar una sola línea del código original, ExpansionHunter corrió de principio a fin sobre el recorte autosómico Illumina BAM de GIAB NA12878 (`hg38`) y genotipó los 24/24 loci STR forenses del panel de referencia con estado PASS.
es.base: Binario oficial precompilado de ExpansionHunter v5.0.0 (GitHub Releases, documentado en `docs/02_Installation.md`)
recommendations: En `docs/02_Installation.md` (línea 19), reemplazar `zlib1g` por `zlib1g-dev` para que las compilaciones desde fuente en Ubuntu/Debian cuenten con las cabeceras de desarrollo de ZLIB.

En `CMakeLists.txt` (línea 44), reemplazar la URL retirada `https://boostorg.jfrog.io/artifactory/main/release/1.73.0/source/boost_1_73_0.tar.bz2` por el archivo oficial de Boost (`https://archives.boost.io/release/1.73.0/source/boost_1_73_0.tar.bz2`) para que la compilación desde cero vuelva a funcionar.

Agregar un comando copiable de instalación para el tarball oficial de GitHub Releases (o Bioconda `expansionhunter=5.0.0`) directamente en `README.md` para que evaluadores automáticos puedan correr v5.0.0 sin compilar Boost desde fuente.

pt.plain_why: A verificação automática falhou ao compilar a partir do código-fonte porque as instruções do Ubuntu omitem `zlib1g-dev` e o `CMakeLists.txt` aponta para uma URL desativada do Boost. Na verificação manual, usando o binário oficial pré-compilado v5.0.0 documentado pelos autores (sem modificar código), o ExpansionHunter rodou de ponta a ponta e chamou todos os 24 loci STR forenses (veja a Seção 4 para os passos exatos).
pt.without_preparation: A verificação automática compila a partir do código-fonte seguindo `docs/02_Installation.md` (linha 19), que lista `zlib1g` em vez de `zlib1g-dev` no Ubuntu, fazendo o CMake parar antes da compilação. Além disso, mesmo com todos os cabeçalhos de desenvolvimento instalados, `CMakeLists.txt` (linha 44) aponta para a URL desativada `boostorg.jfrog.io` do Boost 1.73.0, que retorna um redirecionamento HTML em vez do `.tar.bz2`.
pt.reason: Usando o binário oficial pré-compilado da release ExpansionHunter v5.0.0 documentado em `docs/02_Installation.md` (linhas 3-5) e sem modificar o código original, o ExpansionHunter executou de ponta a ponta no recorte autossômico Illumina BAM do GIAB NA12878 (`hg38`) e genotipou todos os 24/24 loci STR forenses do painel de referência com status PASS.
pt.base: Binário oficial pré-compilado do ExpansionHunter v5.0.0 (GitHub Releases, documentado em `docs/02_Installation.md`)
recommendations: Em `docs/02_Installation.md` (linha 19), substituir `zlib1g` por `zlib1g-dev` para que compilações a partir do código-fonte no Ubuntu/Debian tenham os cabeçalhos de desenvolvimento da ZLIB.

Em `CMakeLists.txt` (linha 44), substituir a URL desativada `https://boostorg.jfrog.io/artifactory/main/release/1.73.0/source/boost_1_73_0.tar.bz2` pelo arquivo oficial do Boost (`https://archives.boost.io/release/1.73.0/source/boost_1_73_0.tar.bz2`) para restaurar a compilação limpa.

Adicionar um comando copiável de instalação do tarball oficial do GitHub Releases (ou Bioconda `expansionhunter=5.0.0`) diretamente no `README.md` para que avaliadores automáticos executem a v5.0.0 sem compilar o Boost do zero.
